[[Black Leopards F.C.|Black Leopards]] (Inland) | promoted = [[AmaZulu F.C.|AmaZulu]], [[Black Leopards F.C.|Black Leopards]] | relegated = | matches = | total goals = | prevseason = [[1999–2000 National First Division|1999–2000]] | nextseason = [[2001–02 National First Division|2001–02]] }} The '''2000–01 National First Division''' was the 5th season of [[National First Division|the second tier]] of South African [[Association football|soccer]] since the reorganisation in 1996. It consisted of two streams, an Inland stream of 16 teams, and a Coastal stream of 14 teams. The Coastal stream was won by [[AmaZulu F.C.|AmaZulu]] and the Inland stream by [[Black Leopards F.C.|Black Leopards]], with both earning promotion to the [[2001–02 Premier Soccer League]].{{Cite web
